jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**As Trial Insights Manager in Trial Performance Insights, you will lead the analysis that shapes where global Phase I–IV clinical trials run. You will turn data from multiple sources into clear, evidence-based country allocation recommendations for trial planners and Clinical Operations teams. Your work will inform feasibility, enrolment forecasts and operational decisions, helping trials start on solid ground and move forward at pace for people living with serious chronic diseases.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• A Master’s degree or equivalent in life sciences, data science, statistics, economics, engineering, business administration or another relevant field.

• Significant experience in one or more of the following areas: analytics, clinical operations, trial planning, feasibility, data science, consulting or related R&D business support.

• Strong analytical and conceptual problem-solving skills, and the ability to handle complexity and ambiguity with limited predefined procedures.

• Strong experience with analytical tools such as SQL, Power BI, Python, R, Excel or similar is preferred; alternatively, a strong background in clinical operations is equally valued.

• Experience with scenario modelling, analytical tool development, data integration, dashboards or reproducible analytics.

• Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and translating complex data into business recommendations.

• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with clear communication and presentation skills.

• A quality mindset focused on traceability, reproducibility and documentation.

• The ability to coach or guide less experienced colleagues.

• Training in advanced analytics, project management, clinical trial operations or data engineering.

**What You’ll Do

**You will act as a lead analytical contributor in trial support, running complex analyses and selected projects with trial planners, Clinical Operations and stakeholders inside and outside TP-AP.

• Lead analytical work packages that support country allocation, feasibility assessment, enrolment forecasting and operational decisions for global Phase I–IV trials.

• Define analytical approaches, integrate multiple data sources and run scenario analyses to deliver robust outputs for medium and high-complexity trial planning questions.

• Develop and quality assure analytical input on country allocation scenarios, recruitment assumptions and operational feasibility.

• Translate data and operational insight into clear recommendations, and facilitate data-driven dialogue that explains assumptions and builds alignment.

• Plan, scope and deliver analytical projects, including stakeholder mapping, timelines and risk identification.

• Build, test and maintain analytical tools, dashboards, reusable code and data pipelines, and drive automation and scalability of methods and outputs.

• Document assumptions, data sources, limitations, methodology and review steps transparently, and help shape standards for data, analytics and quality review.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Trial Performance Insights in Research & Development, where colleagues bring together curiosity, data, technology and collaboration to help advance scientific ideas into clinical testing.

Your closest partners will be trial planners and Clinical Operations teams, who rely on your analysis to make country allocation and feasibility decisions. You will also work with colleagues in TP-AP, Global Trial Allocation and related R&D functions to align on assumptions, share better practice and develop common analytical standards. The work covers global trials, so you will bring different perspectives together, create clarity and help teams move from insight to decision.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work on complex questions with real influence on how trials are planned. You are trusted to own your work, make your voice heard and shape the standards and tools your colleagues use. You will grow through hands-on project delivery, collaboration across R&D functions and the chance to coach colleagues, in an environment that supports you to perform at your best.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from DKK 651,200 to 956,900, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn complex data into decisions that help trials move forward, apply for the Trial Insights Manager role by **17 November 2026.

**We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Event & Experience Manager – Bring Axlab’s customer experiences to life
jobs.description:
Can you turn a showroom visit, a reference site tour or an industry exhibition into an experience that makes a lasting impression?

In collaboration with Actief Hartmanns, Axlab is looking for an Event & Experience Manager who combines creative design with hands-on delivery and a clear commercial focus.

In the position you will own Axlab’s customer-facing experience programme: reference site visits, the headquarters showroom, Axlab Academy, and industry exhibitions. This is an opportunity to combine concept development with practical execution, shaping how visitors experience Axlab’s solutions and building the calendar, materials and processes that ensure consistent quality and continuity.

Your role goes beyond logistics: you will design welcoming, relevant experiences that help visitors understand how Axlab’s solutions work in practice. You will also build the calendar, materials and documented processes that make the programme consistent, scalable, and less dependent on any one individual.

You will be part of the Marcom team and work closely with Sales, Product Management, and external partners. Together with the Graphic Designer & Event Coordinator, you will translate ideas into a strong exhibition presence and cohesive creative execution.

What you will take ownership of

• Develop and deliver reference site visits, showroom tours, Academy days and exhibitions that connect customer needs with Axlab’s automated pathology workflows.

• Establish and continually improve the showroom experience and reference site concept for prospective and existing customers.

• Manage programmes and events from concept to delivery, aligning internal teams, external agencies, and production partners.

• Build and maintain the activity calendar, supporting materials, briefings, and documented processes.

• Manage suppliers, budgets, and negotiations, with close attention to production details and on-site logistics.

• Track event performance and work with Sales and within Marcom to ensure effective lead handling and handover.

• Help support the development of a sustainable webinar approach that contributes to sales opportunities.

What you bring

You have at least five years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, or customer experience, ideally combining large-scale exhibitions with smaller, hosted experiences. Exhibition or trade show experience is essential, together with relevant experience from the medical device industry. You can demonstrate that you have designed and delivered premium customer or partner experiences, not simply coordinated the logistics.

• A bachelor’s degree or higher in marketing, communications, business, hospitality, or event management, or equivalent experience.

• Experience establishing and improving a showroom for a company providing anatomic pathology equipment or a medical device company.

• Experience developing and refining reference site concepts for prospective and existing customers.

• Strong end-to-end project management skills and the ability to collaborate with Sales, Product Management, and external partners.

• Experience managing vendors, suppliers, and budgets, including negotiations with agencies and production partners.

• Confidence reporting on event performance, handling leads and coordinates their handover.

• Fluency in English. Danish is an advantage when working with headquarters and the local reference site network.

Experience developing a webinar strategy that generates sales opportunities is a plus. Alternatively, you are comfortable learning this skill quickly, as you will work closely with your future colleagues in Marcom on this.

Regular travel should be expected, and in busy periods, this can be 50% or more.

A thoughtful host with a hands-on mindset

You make people feel genuinely welcome and adapt naturally to different visitors and situations. You stay calm when plans change, take pride in the details and are just as comfortable shaping an experience concept as managing the on-site logistics. Open and approachable, you build trust with colleagues, suppliers and senior stakeholders, communicate clear briefs, and know who needs which information — and when.

You bring creativity, initiative and a collaborative approach. You are curious about what works, use data and feedback to improve the programme and look for ways to make each visit or event meaningful rather than routine.

Axlab’s Marcom team works to build recognition of the Axlab brand for bringing innovation and automation to pathology laboratories in its direct markets. Through consistent brand storytelling, impactful events, customer experiences and digital channels, the team connects colleagues and customers with that ambition. In this role, you will have ownership of the experiences that show what it means in practice.

What we offer

We are a small yet ambitious growth company where our shared values — Decency, Innovation, Commitment, and Responsibility — form the foundation of everything we do. We offer a flexible, hybrid, and trust-based full-time position where you will have influence on both your own role and the continued development of our Marcom function. Occasional travel activity must be expected as part of the role.

• Competitive salary and employment conditions

• A highly visible role with direct access to senior leadership

• Influence on business decisions and strategic initiatives

• Professional and personal development opportunities

• An international and collaborative working environment

• Welcoming and comfortable office space with everyday perks including free refreshments and daily lunch buffet

• Social activities and annual global events

Interested?

Are you interested in the position? Please submit your application and CV via the application button – we look forward to hearing from you.

If you have any questions about the position and would like to learn more, you are welcome to contact Senior Recruitment Consultant at Actief Hartmanns, Anne-Mette Juncker Davidsen, by phone +45 4121 1344 or by email: anne-mette.davidsen@actief-hartmanns.dk.

Actief Hartmanns A/S is handling the entire recruitment process on behalf of Axlab, and therefore all inquiries should be directed to us. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of age, gender, disability, ethnic background, religion, or nationality.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found, even before the application deadline.

Are you a science student looking to gain hands-on experience in a global R&D environment? Do you thrive in a structured setting, enjoy organizing information, and have a keen eye for quality and safety? If so, we would love to hear from you.

We are looking for a Student Assistant to join our R&D Laboratory Management team at Hempel's headquarters in Kongens Lyngby, Denmark.

In this role, you will help ensure that our laboratories operate safely, efficiently, and in compliance with relevant standards, while supporting our R&D teams with a variety of practical and administrative tasks. Your contributions will help create the best possible conditions for our researchers and specialists to focus on developing innovative Hempel products.

You will become part of a dedicated team of two colleagues and collaborate closely with our service team to support eight R&D departments comprising approximately 100 employees. We offer a dynamic and international working environment, providing valuable exposure to laboratory operations, process improvements, and cross-functional collaboration.

Working hours are 15-20 hours per week, with flexibility to accommodate your studies and exam periods.

**What will your responsibilities be?

**As our Student Assistant, you will support a range of activities related to laboratory operations, quality, and safety, including:

• Maintaining, updating, and sharing laboratory data and documentation

• Supporting calibration and maintenance activities for laboratory equipment

• Managing and updating chemical and safety databases

• Assisting with laboratory registrations, documentation, and process improvements

• Supporting 5S and continuous improvement initiatives

• Assisting with chemical handling and safeguarding activities

• Checking in materials and supporting inventory-related tasks

• Providing ad hoc support to R&D teams and laboratory management

**What We're Looking For

**

• You are currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree within a scientific discipline, such as Chemistry, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related field.

• Previous laboratory experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

**We Imagine That You

**

• Are well-organized and able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

• Have a structured and detail-oriented approach to your work

• Take pride in delivering high-quality results

• Are comfortable working with digital systems and databases

• Enjoy practical laboratory work

• Have a service-minded and collaborative attitude towards many different stakeholders

• Communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken

• Have an interest in laboratory safety, risk management, equipment calibration, quality standards, compliance, and continuous improvement, and be motivated to contribute to a safe and efficient R&D environment.

**What We Offer

**At Hempel, you'll gain valuable hands-on experience in a global R&D organization while working alongside experienced colleagues who are passionate about safety, quality, and innovation.

This is an excellent opportunity to build practical laboratory and operational skills, contribute to meaningful projects, and develop a strong understanding of how laboratory management supports research and development in an international company.

We will conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

Application due

2026-11-08

Seniority Level

Internship

Job Functions

Research

Industry

Chemicals

_At Hempel, you’re welcomed to a global community of +7000 colleagues around the world. A workplace built on shared trust, mutual respect and support for each other.

__We’re on a mission to double our impact. To succeed, we need bright minds and team players. Which is why, from day one, your input, ideas and initiative are not only welcomed, but expected. In return, you will enjoy great opportunities for development in a growing global company – and be part of the solution by contributing to our global impact.

_At Hempel, we are committed to everyone feeling safe, valued and treated equally, in an environment where each employee can bring their authentic selves to work. We believe that inclusion is key to innovation and by bringing together the most diverse perspectives and talents, we can achieve great things, together.

About Churney

At Churney, we’re building the signal layer between company data and AI and advertising systems, enabling business-outcome-optimized AI at scale. We help advertisers make smarter, long-term decisions. We've built a system that maximizes Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) by sending predicted lifetime value (pLTV) conversion events to platforms like Google and Meta. The result: better bidding, higher returns and measurable impact.

We’re a small team growing fast, in a research-driven environment with ambitious, highly capable and collaborative teammates. Our ambition is to build the best experimentation culture in the world, and we value shared learning above all else. The impact of your work is directly measurable so you'll have a uniquely fast feedback loop on the outcomes you’re driving.

You’ll be expected to bring high energy, a growth mindset and a deep care for clients.

• You'll be trusted early. You won't spend weeks shadowing. You'll own real client relationships quickly, and what matters is whether those clients grow with Churney.

• We expect you to be hungry to learn the ins and outs of our tech stack, the ad platforms, and how pLTV can improve advertisers across different industries.

The role

You’ll be the technical bridge between Churney and our clients - integrating their data, shaping modeling decisions, running our ML pipelines to turn raw user data into value signals, validating real-world impact in the ad platforms, ensuring a smooth onboarding experience, and guiding clients to adopt our services at scale.

It's a genuinely hybrid role spanning data engineering, ML, ad-platform measurement, and client communication — which means broad exposure to the whole business and the chance to become a domain expert in an industry that turns over hundreds of billions of dollars a year, while working alongside some of the best engineers around.

We are looking for smart, motivated problem solvers who learn fast and want their work to have measurable impact. We welcome both junior and experienced candidates.

What you'll do

• Integrate client data — connect cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift) and map messy, real-world data into our common data model.

• Configure and run our pLTV pipelines — set up and experiment within our production modeling pipeline to produce pLTV value signals.

• Own measurement and experimentation — design and run experiments (geo, A/B, lift, pre/post), diagnose signal loss and match quality in the Meta and Google interfaces (EMQ, signal ratio), and size the opportunity before launch.

• Validate impact and iterate — analyze results, confirm the signal is driving real ROAS, and tighten the loop.

• Communicate with clients — build a collaborative partnership with the client, present opportunity sizing and results to client stakeholders, proactively resolve issues, and drive adoption at scale.

• Improve the platform — collaborate with client leads and internal teams to automate toil and raise the quality of our tools and processes.

What we're looking for

• Strong Python and SQL — comfortable in large, messy datasets.

• Solid ML foundations — you understand modeling trade-offs even if you're not training models from scratch here.

• Excellent communication — you can explain a technical result to a non-technical client and hold the relationship.

• A measurement mindset (or strong appetite for one) — curiosity about how ad attribution, identifiers, and incrementality actually work.

• Ownership and comfort with ambiguity — you can run multiple client projects at once in a space where the playbook is still being written.

• An automation and improvement instinct — you'd rather fix the workflow than repeat the toil.

Nice to have

• Experience with ad platforms and performance marketing (Google, Meta, TikTok).

• Direct, hands-on client experience.

• Modern cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift).

• Background in A/B testing, causal inference, or LTV modeling.

• Experience building internal tooling or agentic AI workflows to speed up the above.

If you learn quickly, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to apply your data science skills to real, measurable client impact, we'd love to talk.

Apply for this role

Tell us about yourself below, we read every application. You’re also welcome to apply by email at gaja@churney.io.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role as Senior QC Scientist (BioAssay)

**Are you motivated by the opportunity to help build something from the ground up? Genmab is establishing a QC Laboratory, and we are looking for a Senior QC Scientist for a BioAssay team to play a central role in this work.

This is a unique opportunity to help implement methods, shape key processes, and set the standard for how our QC organization will operate in the years ahead.

You will play a key role in the establishment of the laboratory which includes and is not limited to: Method transfers, Validation of Analytical methods, authoring and reviewing laboratory procedures, and supporting qualification of new analytical instruments.

Collaboration and cross-site training with our analytical development group in Utrecht and analytical SME´s in Copenhagen will also be expected in the beginning

The position is an onsite role in our QC Lab in Ballerup and reports to Associate Director, Head of QC BioAssay

**Once In Operation Daily Tasks Includes

**

• Reviewing release and stability analyzes,

• Supporting and training fellow scientists and lab technicians

• Documenting validation activities of analytical methods for clinical phase I/II and III and authoring SOPs.

**Requirements

**

• Master's degree or PhD in chemistry, biology, pharmacy, biotechnology, or related scientific area.

• At least 6+ years of experience in a Quality Control (QC) or analytical development (AD) laboratory or a PhD degree with 3+ years of working experience.

• Strong understanding of analytical science and its application across clinical development stages.

• Good understanding of validation concepts, risk-based approaches, and regulatory expectations.

• Experience with systems and tools relevant to QC (e.g. LIMS, SAS-Jmp, SoftMaxPro)

• You have experience with ELISA´s and pharmacopeia methods for biologics.

**Why Join Us?

**This is a rare opportunity to shape a laboratory from the ground up. You will be part of a highly motivated and international team, working with cutting-edge science and innovative therapies. If you are energized by challenges, driven by curiosity, and eager to see your impact on both processes and people, we want you on the team.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Build Intelligent Systems That Create Real Impact

Are you motivated by solving complex problems with data and AI?

Do you enjoy transforming business challenges into scalable, production-ready solutions?

At VENZO, we’re expanding our Data & AI team and are looking for experienced profiles across mid-to-senior level — from strong hands-on engineers to technical leaders who can shape architecture and guide others.

If you want your work to move beyond experimentation and into real-world implementation, this could be the right place for you.

About VENZO

At VENZO, we believe in the power of technology to create meaningful change – today, not tomorrow.

You’ll join a team of specialists who live and breathe digital transformation, helping some of Denmark’s largest and most influential organizations turn data into action. Here, innovation isn’t a buzzword – it’s how we think, collaborate, and deliver.

About the Role

You will contribute directly to the design, development, and deployment of advanced data and AI systems in cloud-based environments.

Your responsibilities may include:

• Architecting and implementing end-to-end AI and machine learning solutions

• Deploying, monitoring, and optimizing models on cloud platforms

• Translating business requirements into structured technical solutions

• Ensuring solutions are maintainable, scalable, and aligned with best practices

• Evaluating and applying emerging technologies within AI and GenAI

For more senior candidates, the role also includes:

• Defining technical direction and architectural standards

• Acting as a primary technical contact for clients

• Leading workstreams and mentoring team members

• Contributing to the evolution of our Data & AI capabilities and service offerings

We value profiles who can combine deep technical execution with sound judgment in real client environments.

Your Background

We are open to different experience levels, provided you bring strong fundamentals and practical experience.

Experience and Education

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience

• 2+ years of experience in data engineering or AI/ML, delivering production-ready solutions

• Hands-on experience across the full ML lifecycle — from experimentation to deployment and monitoring

• Experience with generative AI

• For senior profiles: experience leading technical initiatives or mentoring others

Technical Capabilities

You have experience working within modern data and AI ecosystems, including:

• Programming: Python and SQL, Typescript is a plus

• Cloud: Microsoft Azure (e.g., Azure ML, Data Factory) or other cloud plattforms

• Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow)

• Machine Learning: Classical ML techniques and generative AI applications

• GenAI Tooling: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, frameworks such as LangChain or Microsoft Agent Framework

• MLOps: CI/CD, model lifecycle management, orchestration tools, version control

• Data Engineering: ETL processes and large-scale data processing

How You Work

• Analytical and structured in your problem-solving approach

• Comfortable operating in client-facing environments

• Able to communicate complex technical topics in business-relevant terms

• Pragmatic, quality-driven, and accountable for outcomes

What You Can Expect From Us

• Meaningful, technically challenging projects with real business visibility

• A strong professional environment with high standards and high trust

• Autonomy in how you structure and deliver your work

• Access to modern tooling, platforms, and certifications (including Microsoft)

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits

• Continuous development — technically and professionally

Let’s Talk

Send your CV or a short introduction to hr@venzo.com.

We’re happy to meet for a coffee and explore whether there’s a mutual fit.

We’re looking for a data platform lead with a commercial mindset, ready to help our clients find out where AI fits and to play a central role in growing their business around it.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you’ll advise clients on their data platform and AI choices, design the architectures, build them yourself, and lead the teams that deliver them. It’s a role that’s equal parts business-facing and technical: you’ll design and build on Snowflake, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric, and be just as at home in the client meeting.

Beyond the client work, you’ll team up with colleagues across The Tech Collective and Implement to spot opportunities, shape scopes, and help win the work. Having built these platforms makes you credible when you sell them, and selling them keeps you building what clients need. As the team grows, you’ll also help shape the offering itself: reference architectures, propositions, and people.

What You’ll Bring

You’re a builder at heart. You have experience designing and delivering data platforms in at least one of Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and you can weigh them against each other. To be a great fit, it helps if you have:

• A commercial mindset – you spot opportunities, shape scopes, contribute to proposals, and are comfortable in a room with senior business stakeholders

• Fluency in AI and how it depends on the data platform – from data foundations and governance to taking AI use cases into production

• Experience leading projects or engineering teams (e.g., as an engineering manager or tech lead) while staying close to the code

• Clear communication with both engineers and executives, and the ability to turn platform choices into business decisions

• A collaborative style – you develop the people around you and enjoy building something together with others

What We Offer

At The Tech Collective, you’ll be part of a team that blends nerdiness, energy, and a sincere interest in people. You’ll have influence over how we grow, close sparring with experienced peers, and the chance to shape the offering as it develops.

Our culture is built on high autonomy with responsibility, co-creation, and active knowledge-sharing. You’ll work on projects across industries and disciplines – from strategy rooms to solution pilots with leading technologies. And to support your growth, we also provide internal training, keynotes, and hands-on learning across AI, data, cyber, and digital strategy.

How To Apply

• We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application ASAP

• Please apply with your CV, cover letter, and university transcripts

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI, and analytics, ensuring that they are ready for what comes next.

Ready to shape the digital future with us?

**_Help customers turn technology into solutions they use every day.

_**At Trackunit, our IrisX industry cloud platform unlocks insights, benchmarks, and innovation through connected construction data. As a Solution Delivery Engineer, you’ll help customers successfully implement and adopt Manager and IrisX, making these platforms part of their everyday operations.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer engagement. You’ll configure solutions, build integrations, and work with customer teams to translate their needs into practical results. Along the way, you’ll collaborate with colleagues across Trackunit and explore a wide range of technologies and customer environments.

****What’s in it for you

******A broad technical playground

**You’ll work across platform configuration, software development, integrations, and data engineering. Depending on the project, you could use Python and SQL, JavaScript or TypeScript, REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks and Databricks. There’s room to apply your strengths while building experience in new areas.

**Customer projects with tangible outcomes

**Your work will help construction companies connect their systems, improve their data, and adopt new ways of working. You’ll see solutions through to practical use and understand how your contribution helps customers get more value from Trackunit.

**Collaboration across disciplines

**You’ll work closely with Solution Delivery colleagues, Sales Engineering, IoT Services, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. You’ll have opportunities to learn from different specialisms, share your knowledge, and contribute customer insights that help improve our platforms.

**Ownership and professional growth

**You’ll take responsibility for meaningful parts of customer delivery, with scope reflecting your experience and strengths. Whether you want to deepen your technical expertise, develop your customer-facing skills, or take on more complex implementations, you’ll have opportunities to grow through practical work, coaching, and feedback.

**The Opportunity To Shape How We Deliver

**Beyond individual projects, you’ll help develop reusable solutions, implementation patterns, and documentation. Your ideas and experience will contribute to making future deliveries more effective across the global Solution Delivery team.

**An international and flexible workplace

**You’ll join a global team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and personal development, with a flexible working setup and connections across teams and borders.

****What you’ll work on

******Solution implementation and adoption

**Configure, extend, test, and deploy Manager and IrisX solutions to fit customer workflows and help customers put them into use.

**Integrations and data pipelines

**Connect Trackunit with customer systems such as ERP, CRM, and fleet management tools through APIs, webhooks, and data flows, supporting reliable and secure data exchange.

**Applied data and analytics

**Turn connected construction data into useful insights, supporting use cases such as equipment fault analysis, benchmarking, and emissions reporting, and other customer-specific analytics use cases.

**Customer enablement

**Work with customer teams through technical workshops, training, and implementation support, helping them confidently operate and adopt the solutions delivered.

**Coordinated delivery and continuous improvement

**Collaborate with internal teams and customer stakeholders on implementation activities and clear handovers. Share delivery learnings and customer feedback with Product and Engineering to improve the platform and future deployments.

**Bring your curiosity and perspective

**There are different paths into Solution Delivery. Your experience might come from software engineering, data, integrations, technical consulting, or practical projects that you’re ready to build on.

You don’t need to know every technology we use. We’re interested in how you approach problems, collaborate with others, and connect technical work with customer needs.

If you enjoy building solutions and helping people put them to work, we’d love to hear from you.

**Our hiring process

**Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Virtual second interview / in-person with the hiring manager and the team.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a peer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

**Overview

**Corti is the frontier lab for clinical-grade AI, building world-leading models and infrastructure for the realities of healthcare.

Our technology powers healthcare’s most ambitious software, from EHR vendors and virtual care platforms to the health systems that care depends on. We work with builders ranging from fast-moving startups to global healthcare enterprises, helping them bring clinical AI into real-world care.

Healthcare is full of problems where AI has to do more than simply work. Clinicians are overwhelmed by documentation. Coding errors, backlogs and denials cost health systems billions. And the specialist expertise patients need is not always available when they need it.

We build AI specifically for these environments, trained on real patient interactions, validated against real outcomes, and designed to perform where accuracy, trust and reliability matter. If you want to help define how AI is built for healthcare, you belong at Corti.

The Role

We’re looking for a GTM Engineer to help build the systems behind a smarter, more scalable go-to-market engine at Corti. You’ll connect the tools and data that power our commercial teams, turning fragmented systems into a reliable foundation for automation, insight, and action.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, data, and business impact. You’ll partner closely with Growth, Sales, DevEx Growth, and Platform to design workflows, improve data quality, and build the internal products and automations that help us move faster as we scale.

What you'll do

Data foundation

• Build and maintain the integrated data layer across Corti’s commercial data systems, bringing together data from tools such as Stripe, Attio, Supabase, Calendly, and Leexi.

• Own the event tracking layer, instrumenting key product and commercial touchpoints so analytics tools (PostHog, Mixpanel, etc.) reflect what's actually happening.

• Build enrichment pipelines that pull from third-party data providers and internal signals to keep ICP records current and scored.

Systems and automation

• Design and implement workflows, automations, and backend services that improve how commercial teams operate, from pipeline management and deal acceleration to post-sale handoffs.

• Identify repetitive GTM processes and systematically eliminate them through automation, freeing commercial teams to focus on higher-judgment work.

Activation and tooling

• Build systems that surface timely signals and enable proactive, data-driven GTM execution, including AI-powered internal tools and agentic workflows where appropriate.

• Build internal tools that reduce manual work for sales, CS, and growth, such as automated account research, meeting prep summaries, or usage-based alert systems.

• Partner with Growth and RevOps to define the data models and pipeline logic that underpin campaign targeting, segmentation, and attribution.

Cross-functional impact

• Collaborate as the primary technical builder for GTM teams across Growth, Enterprise Sales, Developer Experience, and Scaled Customer Experience, translating process needs into robust, scalable solutions.

• Document all built components so systems remain understandable and extensible as the team scales.

• Contribute to engineering quality through clean implementation, thoughtful code review, and cross-functional collaboration.

What you bring

• Experience as a software engineer, ideally at mid-level, with exposure to growth, sales, or other go-to-market teams.

• Strong proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript, with a backend or server-side engineering focus.

• Experience integrating business-critical tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, or similar systems.

• Familiarity with analytics and data tooling such as PostHog, Mixpanel, Segment, Google Analytics, Amplitude, or Google Tag Manager.

• Experience working with ETL processes, data synchronization, or workflow automation is a plus, but not required.

• Excellent English verbal and written communication skills, including all-remote communication.

Life at Corti

• You will be reporting to VP of Growth

• The position is full-time and starts as soon as possible.

• Hybrid working environment in Copenhagen

• Equipment provided by Corti

**Ready to dive into the world of Corti? Apply today, and let's start working together on reshaping the dialogue in healthcare, making a real difference for millions of patient outcomes around the world.

We encourage applications from all people and do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, and/or disability status._At Corti, experience comes in many forms, and we’re passionate about creating teams with a multitude of perspectives! If you believe your experience is close to what we’re looking for but not an exact match, we still hope you’ll consider applying!

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant for Software Development at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Student Assistant for Software Development at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you're energised by software development and thrive on solving real business challenges through technology, we'd love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a student software developer to join our system development team in Global IT.

As a team, we support NNE's engineering project portfolios and build modern applications that help colleagues work smarter across projects and locations.

As a student software developer, you will play an important role in supporting the team's development efforts by contributing to real business-critical solutions, helping maintain high quality through testing, and bringing fresh perspectives on emerging technologies such as Azure and AI.

This is a part-time position of around 2–3 days a week. You will work on real tasks from day one, with a dedicated colleague to guide you, review your code and help you grow.

How you might spend your days

As a student software developer, you’ll be:

• Developing new features and fixing bugs in our applications, APIs and services

• Building front-end components and backend endpoints under guidance from experienced developers

• Helping perform testing of our applications, running test cases, reporting defects and writing automated tests to keep our quality high

• Taking part in our agile ways of working, stand-ups, sprint planning and code reviews

• Exploring new tools and technologies, such as cloud services on Microsoft Azure and AI and sharing what you learn with the team

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• A self-learner who picks up new technologies and tools on your own initiative and is not afraid to ask questions when you get stuck

• Structured and responsible, taking ownership of your tasks and delivering what you commit to

• Collaborative and comfortable working with colleagues across disciplines, locations and cultures

• Curious and proactive in suggesting improvements to tools, processes and technical solutions

• Open to feedback and ready to learn from mistakes, with high spirits and a sense of humour

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Are studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field

• Have a basic understanding of programming in C#/.NET or Python

• Have some experience with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and ideally a modern framework such as React

• Know the basics of relational databases and SQL

• Have used Git for version control

• Communicate well in English, written and spoken

It’s a bonus if you have tried automated testing, CI/CD or cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure.

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 15 November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Ivanna Jurkiv Ditlevsen at +45 3077 4721.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

jobs.occupation: (Senior) Product Creation Learning Partner – Maternity Cover (Minimum 12 Months)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building change management and learning capabilities and fostering a learning culture at scale? Do you thrive when working with tools and processes, and are you naturally curious about finding new ways to use them? If so, you could be our Senior Product Creation Learning Partner during a maternity cover of at least 12 months.

At 3Shape, Product Creation is our term for R&D. It represents the organization responsible for developing and improving our products across hardware, software, engineering, and related product-development disciplines.

We are looking for an experienced learning partner to join us on a fixed-term maternity cover. In this role, you will build and embed a scalable capability framework that ensures Product Creation teams are equipped to work effectively across processes, tools, and ways of working.

During the maternity-cover period, you will use your stakeholder-engagement skills and your ability to align and influence across organizational levels and functions. You will combine these strengths with solid experience in building and maintaining training frameworks and structures that fit the organization’s needs.

You will be part of the Product Creation Excellence (PCE) team, which consists of around 10 people, all based in Denmark. Together, we enable Product Creation and adjacent functions across processes, training, tools, strategy, and transformation.

Core Responsibilities

Training framework & architecture

• Define the learning and capability framework and structures that support tool and process adoption, ways of working, and competence building: Standardize how training is designed, deployed, and maintained (including anchoring structures, super-user and ambassador methodologies, communities of practice, learning journeys, etc.).

• Continuously improve and expand the learning and capability framework and plan for Product Creation in collaboration with the Product Creation team.

• Develop and anchor training: Enable and support the organization to own and deliver training locally where appropriate, while ensuring central support and training structures are available where needed.

Capability mapping and training roll-out

• Continuously map and prioritize training needs with stakeholders based on business needs, maturity across technical functions, necessity, and criticality.

• Define and drive rollout plans in collaboration with functional owners and/or the PCE team.

• Establish regular cadences for training areas and structures, ensuring an appropriate frequency of training events, reviews of training materials, trainer setup and coaching, and cycles for communities of practice and other learning environments.

Integration with business & transformation

• Ensure alignment with transformation initiatives and operating model changes.

• Support change management and the adoption of new practices.

Capability tracking & improvement

• Define and follow up on KPIs for capability building (e.g., adoption, proficiency, and coverage).

• Drive feedback loops and the continuous improvement of the training setup.

• Maintain an overview of capability gaps and critical skill needs.

This role may involve some travel.

Ideal profile:

For this role, we believe a good fit is someone who can bring:

• Experience in building learning frameworks in complex medical regulated R&D or technology organizations (including experience with different training and learning models, e.g., train-the-trainer, communities of practice, coaching, and online training).

• A collaborative, team-oriented mindset. We depend on strong teamwork within the PCE team and across other teams and functions, so it is essential that you thrive when working with others to solve challenges and realize opportunities.

• An understanding of and/or interest in how different profiles learn, with the ability to balance technical tool training with soft skills such as leadership.

• Experience with change management and the large-scale rollout and/or adoption of new processes, preferably in a large R&D or other technical environment.

• Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to build bridges between technical and non-technical functions.

• The ability to drive adoption without formal authority.

Join us in shaping a company culture that makes Monday mornings worth it.

At 3Shape, you will join an international R&D environment in central Copenhagen, working closely with advanced hardware, software, and engineering teams that develop products to improve dental care globally. You will have the opportunity to shape learning and capability-building practices and see your work make a direct difference for colleagues.

We are a vibrant, visionary, and international place to work. But most of all, we are a diverse group of over 50 different nationalities who all contribute to a thriving company culture. We partake in social clubs, monthly social activities, and various in-team activities as well. If that’s not enough, then add on:

• Central Copenhagen location.

• A globally recognized technology company.

• An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

• Breakfast every day and a delicious, healthy lunch prepared by our private chefs.

• A joint purpose: to enable dentists to provide superior dental care to every patient, every time.

Apply Now

Join us for a maternity cover of at least 12 months and be part of a team improving treatment and care in a meaningful industry. We encourage all qualified professionals who are passionate about building strong learning capabilities in a complex product-development environment to apply.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis; however, we plan to conduct interviews in October and November.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

jobs.occupation: Application Specialist, TMS Sea, Air & Logistics
jobs.description:
Do you have experience within Sea & Air Freight and an interest in IT, systems and process improvements?

At Blue Water Shipping, we are implementing CargoWise across our global organization and working towards more common processes across countries and business units.

To support this work, we are looking for an Application Specialist to join our TMS Sea, Air & Logistics (SEAL) team.  In this role, you will help ensure that our transport management system supports daily business needs and efficient ways of working across the organization.

About the role

You will become part of the SEAL Product Team within Digital Products, Global IT, working in an agile DevOps setup. The team is responsible for developing, maintaining and improving solutions that support our global Sea & Air business. As an Application Specialist, you will work closely with freight forwarding specialists, key users and colleagues in IT. Your focus will be to support and develop our transport management solutions to meet business needs and ensure stable operations. This role offers a chance to influence both processes and systems in a global organization working to standardize and improve processes across countries and business units.

Your key responsibilities

• Provide 2nd level support and maintenance of Blue Water's Sea & Air transport management solutions.

• Support the ongoing global CargoWise implementation and optimization initiative.

• Configure, test and deploy new functionality and system enhancements within CargoWise, including workflows, documents and reports.

• Work with users and business representatives to understand requirements and translate them into system solutions and product improvements.

• Support the testing, implementation and rollout of new CargoWise releases.

• Help ensure adoption of new functionality and ways of working across the business.

• Develop and maintain system documentation, user guides and knowledge articles.

• Support training activities and share knowledge with key users and colleagues.

• Participate in sprint planning, prioritization and ongoing improvements of our solutions.

• Follow up on solution performance and support continuous improvements together with users and key stakeholders.

About you

You have a background within Sea & Air freight forwarding and a genuine interest in systems, digital tools and process improvements.

Ideally, you bring:

• Experience from Sea & Air Freight Forwarding, preferably combined with Super User, System Administrator or project responsibilities.

• Experience with transport management systems, particularly CargoWise.

• CargoWise certification is considered an advantage.

• Knowledge of industry processes within international freight forwarding and logistics.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with users, business representatives and IT colleagues.

• A structured and analytical approach with the ability to work systematically with processes, systems and business needs.

• Experience working in agile environments or a willingness to learn.

• An interest in AI, automation and digital technologies, and how they can contribute to improving business processes and ways of working.

• A proactive attitude and a willingness to take initiative and drive improvements.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Most importantly, you enjoy working with others, solving problems and finding practical solutions that support the business. You are a team player who values collaboration and knowledge sharing across teams and functions.

What we offer

At Blue Water Shipping, we believe great results are created by people who enjoy their work and have the opportunity to grow. We offer an informal working environment where collaboration, trust and professional development are important parts of everyday life.

When joining us, you can expect:

• The opportunity to influence the global implementation and development of CargoWise.

• Professional and personal development in an international organization.

• A high level of responsibility and influence.

• Close collaboration across business and IT.

• Flexible working conditions and a supportive team environment.

• The opportunity to contribute to digitalization and continuous improvement initiatives within a global logistics organization.

Location & Application

🏡 Flexible working conditions: We offer flexibility and the possibility to combine office and remote work.

📅 Application deadline: 30/11-2026

📞 Questions about the position: For more information, feel free to contact Helle S. Christensen, Senior Manager, on +45 24984614.

At Siteimprove, we are the leader in agentic content intelligence. Siteimprove.ai is a unified platform that brings together accessibility, analytics, SEO/AEO, and content strategy into a single, continuous flow. Our AI agents work alongside marketing and digital teams — not instead of them — helping to create high-performing, accessible content that's easy to discover by both humans and AI.

As Senior Engineering Manager for Content Platform, you own the systems that acquire and ingest the content our entire product line reasons about. Our enterprise customers bring thousands of sites each, re-crawled continuously. Every accessibility finding, analytics number, and SEO recommendation begins as content one of your systems fetched, parsed, and stored.

You will lead two Copenhagen engineering teams, each with its own Technical Leader role held by a Principal Engineer. The two carry different hard problems. One sustains crawl throughput so that cost tracks value rather than volume. The other builds the shared foundations the rest of Siteimprove works through, so product lines reach content through common contracts rather than each solving it their own way. You represent this group's engineering in a trio with Product and UX. Pillar strategy is set with Seattle, nine hours behind you, and you are the leader on the ground who turns it into local decisions rather than waiting on it.

Your teams set the ceiling on what the rest of Siteimprove can build. Your goals follow from that — ingestion reliable enough that customers trust it, efficient enough that cost tracks value rather than volume, capable enough to feed our agentic products, and ready for the compliance bar our public sector customers require. You will use AI to build the platform that powers our AI products and stay close enough to the code to argue a design on its merits.

What we will be doing

• Decision Authority in Copenhagen: You are the decision-maker on the ground. Resolve in Copenhagen hours what would otherwise wait overnight. As engineering's voice in the group's trio, bring the constraints Product and UX have no way to see into scope conversations early enough to change them. Your director sets goals with you and discusses how you and the group are tracking against them.

• Platform Ownership: Own Content Platform's ingestion surface as a running business — availability, throughput, cost, and delivery predictability. Modernization is how you improve those numbers, not a separate program you report on. Our move to EKS is part of it. You decide which debt gets paid down and when and keep that trade-off in front of the trio.

• Architectural Direction: Own the constraints and the cross-team contracts your Technical Leaders design within: scheduling the crawl workload so cost tracks value rather than volume, moving ingestion onto event-driven services, and defining how the rest of Siteimprove consumes what we ingest. You will hold that direction with your senior engineers, because authority here is earned in design review.

• Delivery Under Pressure: Hold the delivery line when priorities move. Work arrives from outside the team continuously, and you will sequence so committed work reaches completion rather than stalling half-built. Align directly with peer engineering leaders and close the gaps at functions you depend on but don't manage.

• Measurable Impact: Define the KPIs these systems are judged by and hold your teams to them. You will prove the impact of what you prioritize in throughput, cost, and reliability rather than asserting it, and you will stop work that moves none of them.

• Growing Your Engineers: Own performance, career development, and compensation decisions for the group. Hand the Tech Vision and System Design for major initiatives to the engineers closest to the systems, and review rather than drive them.

• AI-Native Delivery: Use AI for engineering throughput, not just for product features. You will model the practice yourself: interpreting legacy code paths nobody documented, generating test coverage around behavior before you change it, and shortening the distance between a design decision and a working replacement

• Travel may be required; a valid passport is required

• Perform other duties as assigned

What we will require of you

• Ownership at Distance: A group whose outcomes you owned while the people setting direction sat elsewhere. We want evidence of decisions you made rather than escalated, because waiting would have cost more than being wrong. This role also asks for a standing weekly overlap in your late afternoon, when the Seattle day begins, so that the conversation with your director is a working one.

• Systems Depth: 7+ years in backend engineering, with real depth in distributed systems, high-throughput data ingestion, or crawling at scale. Comfort establishing how an undocumented system behaves before changing it, and the instinct to reach for AI to do that quickly.

• Leadership Through Leaders: 10+ years managing engineers, including senior technical leaders whose designs you reviewed rather than produced, and whose scope you expanded rather than absorbed.

• Architectural Judgment: A track record of moving established services onto cloud-native infrastructure and of designing interfaces other teams build on. What matters is having lived with both long enough to know which decisions held and which leaked.

Work Environment

• This is a hybrid role based in our Copenhagen office, with the opportunity to work from both the office and home. Our working language is English.

• Travel may be required up to 5% of the time.

• You will work across a nine-hour spread with product and engineering leadership in Seattle, and with peer teams in other Siteimprove locations. Your late afternoon overlaps the start of the Seattle day, and the role expects you to keep a weekly window there for goal-setting and progress discussions with leadership.

What we will love about you

These systems quietly carry the entire product. If you're ready to make them faster and cheaper to run without stopping the business that depends on them, we'd love to hear from you. Join us in helping enterprise marketing teams turn their vast content into clear, actionable insights that drive measurable business results.

What you'll love about us

We’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

In addition, we hope you will appreciate:

At Siteimprove, we're committed to supporting your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Our Denmark benefits are designed to help you thrive personally and professionally.

Rest and relaxation: Generous time off including Danish holiday entitlements, five additional FF Days, child sick leave, and bereavement leave.

Comprehensive benefits: Health insurance, company-paid mobile phone support, and internet allowance to support your day-to-day needs.

Prepare for the future: Danica pension with employer contributions to help support your retirement goals.

Siteimprove is an equal opportunity employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or other legally protected status.

Siteimprove is a global corporation that has developed data practices to ensure your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

**The Opportunity

**We are looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our Product Engineering organization and help build the digital experiences that teams, coaches, and athletes rely on every week.

In this role, you will work across the full stack—developing scalable backend services, designing resilient APIs, and building responsive, intuitive web interfaces. You’ll be part of a cross-functional product team partnering closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, native mobile engineers, and platform specialists to take ideas from concept to production.

Your work directly influences user engagement, product adoption, and long-term platform value. Whether it involves streamlining how users access and interact with our tools or helping them unlock deeper insights from their matchday media, you will build software that turns video and match data into meaningful, everyday habits for sports communities worldwide.

**What You Will Do

**

• Build and maintain full-stack capabilities, developing scalable backend APIs and high-quality web interfaces.

• Participate in the complete product lifecycle: from initial problem discovery, ideation, feature scoping, technical planning, design discussions, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing iteration based on user data.

• Partner with our native iOS and Android engineers to ensure backend systems and API contracts seamlessly support mobile-first user flows.

• Design clean data models, reliable integrations, and maintainable services with an eye toward performance and scale.

• Incorporate modern AI development tools into your workflow to iterate quickly and build thoughtful software solutions.

• Contribute to technical discussions, code reviews, and shared ownership of the team’s systems.

**What You Could Bring

**

• 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally in a product-led environment.

• Experience working across frontend and backend development.

• A product mindset, with an interest in understanding real user problems and working with Product and Design to turn them into thoughtful technical solutions.

• Backend experience using Python, Rust, or another comparable language, together with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.

• Frontend experience using TypeScript or JavaScript and a modern SPA framework such as React, Vue, or Angular.

• Experience building reliable RESTful or GraphQL APIs for web or native mobile applications.

• A thoughtful approach to automated testing, CI/CD, and maintaining production-quality systems.

• Curiosity about modern AI development tools and how they can support everyday engineering workflows

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

jobs.occupation: Senior Director, Global Support Functions IT
jobs.description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY

**VELUX is the world's most recognised brand in roof windows and skylights, with a genuine mission: creating better living environments through daylight and fresh air. Backed by a foundation with a long-term ownership philosophy, this is a company that thinks in decades, not quarters.

IT in VELUX is entering a new chapter. A new strategy is taking shape, it is high on the Group agenda, and it comes with a clear long-term view of where we are going. At its heart is, of course AI and all the new tech, but even more so, are the platforms that run the business: SAP and Workday, supporting Finance, Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, and People & Organisation.

With a strong foundation already in place, we’re now looking for a leader to take it to the next level - evolving from classic ERP toward AI-enabled ways of working. For a leader who enjoys transformation, wants to shape a roadmap rather than simply run one, and gets energy from solving real problems, this role is worth a conversation.

**What You Will Lead

**You will be accountable for the strategy, delivery, and operation of the enterprise platforms behind VELUX global support functions and be a leader of leaders.

As part of a newly established IT leadership team, reporting to the CIO, you will contribute to the strategic IT agenda beyond your own area. You will own the budget, the key vendor relationships, and the portfolio of programmes across the support functions.

**What The Role Actually Involves

****Stabilising the core and delivering upgrades

**You’ll lead our work on platform reliability: setting up a clear roadmap, solving problems at their source, and keeping stakeholders informed and supported along the way.

**Rethinking the support model

**You’ll have the opportunity to reshape our SAP and Workday support model, building on what works today, including our partnership with an external provider, and shaping how it evolves.

**Prioritising with the business

**The transformation has strong backing, and a big part of the role is making sure effort goes where it creates the most value. With an established PMO behind you, you’ll strengthen portfolio governance and build alignment on priorities.

**Leading the AI shift

**AI is changing everything, including traditional systems. You will help define what AI-enabled ways of working mean for our applications and for our organisation. It is new ground for everyone, and mindset matters as much as technology.

**Who We Are Looking For

**You’re a hands-on IT leader who thinks strategically but isn’t afraid to get into the details. When something breaks, you look past the quick fix to find the real cause, bring the right people together, and make sure it gets properly resolved. People trust you because you deliver on what you promise.

You work in a lean, practical way, and when setting priorities, you involve people rather than handing down a list. You help stakeholders reach a shared view of what matters most, while keeping the conversation focused and constructive.

We are particularly interested in candidates who bring:

• 10+ years of IT leadership, including leading global, multi-disciplinary organisations.

• Experience with enterprise SAP landscapes across Finance, Sales, and Operations/Supply Chain; S/4HANA experience is a strong advantage.

• Experience with HR technology platforms, ideally Workday is an advantage.

• A track record of leading large upgrades and multi-year transformations in a global, matrixed organisation.

• Strong vendor management, including contracts with global system integrators and managed-service providers.

• Curiosity about AI and automation, and a practical view on how they can change the way we work.

• Experience from a manufacturing company is a distinct advantage, and from the building materials industry is a plus.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, “courage” and “mutual respect” define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential.

That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.
